diagnosis: Diffuse large B-cell lymphoma, NOS; non-GCB phenotype by Hans algorithm. Hans non-GCB should not be treated as definitive molecular ABC subtype.
stage: Lugano/Ann Arbor stage III with B symptoms. Disease is above and below the diaphragm with splenic involvement, and the spleen is lymphatic tissue; there is no non-lymphatic extranodal, marrow, or CNS disease to make this stage IV.
biology: Double-hit lymphoma given MYC and BCL2 expression.
prognosis: Use IPI and CNS-IPI. Supplied IPI factors include elevated LDH and stage III disease; age is not over 60, ECOG is 1, and spleen should not be counted as a non-lymphatic extranodal IPI site.
first_line_treatment: Curative-intent immunochemotherapy. Pola-R-CHP or R-CHOP for 6 cycles are appropriate; do not escalate to DA-EPOCH-R solely for double-expressor biology without double-hit rearrangements.
cns_risk: CNS prophylaxis is not automatically indicated from supplied data. Calculate CNS-IPI and assess kidney/adrenal, testicular, breast, and other high-risk anatomical sites; none are documented here.
response_assessment: Use FDG PET-CT with Lugano/Deauville criteria, especially end-of-treatment PET.
missing_information: cardiac function and viral serologies before immunochemotherapy
